headline: Butterfly Gandhimathi opens special window for physical share transfers
hook: New window for physical share re-lodgement

modes.bear: The need for a special re-lodgement window highlights legacy issues in share record-keeping and administrative backlog.
modes.bull: Regulatory compliance reduces long-term administrative friction and potential legal disputes regarding share ownership.
modes.simple: If you hold old-fashioned paper share certificates for this company, you now have a specific opportunity to fix any errors and get your shares ready for digital trading.

summary: Butterfly Gandhimathi Appliances has initiated a special window for the re-lodgement of physical share transfer requests. This move follows a mandate from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to streamline pending physical share documentation. Shareholders holding physical certificates who previously faced rejection or processing delays can now resubmit their requests. This process ensures compliance with current regulatory standards for share dematerialization.
why_it_matters: Physical shareholders can now regularize their holdings for easier trading.

headline: Butterfly Gandhimathi reports 13% revenue growth in September
summary: Butterfly Gandhimathi Appliances reported standalone net sales of Rs 331.47 crore for the quarter ending September 2026. This represents a 13.13% increase compared to the same period last year. The company operates in the kitchen and domestic appliances segment. This performance reflects the company's recent top-line trajectory.
why_it_matters: Signals steady demand for kitchen appliance makers.
